edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: Polypharmacy is partly a marker of illness burden, but cumulative adverse effects, prescribing cascades, and interaction toxicity provide a direct pathway to higher mortality too.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2026 Das meta analysis in BMC Geriatr, which ties polypharmacy to all-cause mortality in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
